BiblicalUsage: The whole city comes out to meet Jesus after He heals the two demoniacs, and when they see Him they beg Him to depart out of their coasts. The King James reading has the noun for a meeting, a coming out to meet Him, though the older Greek copies read a different word for meeting there, and either way the scene is the same: the city meets Jesus and asks Him to leave.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a city can meet Jesus and still ask Him to go, and I hold that I must be careful my meeting with Him ends in welcome, not in dismissal.
